decisions.text: type bar: categories compared by value
clustered bars: 3 series of one measure across categories (G1.56, R9-12)
nominal categories sorted by value, descending (by series cash)
3 series side by side in each cluster, the bars touching, in the same order in every cluster: Cash (slot 1), Credit card (slot 2), Cheque (slot 3) (G7.5, G4.22)
every name fits under its bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart: vertical bars
18 values against 7 scale labels: whichever puts fewer numbers on the chart (G2.18): the values labelled directly, the value scale and its gridlines removed, the zero line kept as the baseline
every label just outside its bar's end: neither the text grey nor white reads on the bar's colour at 4.5 : 1 (G7.4, G6.5)
the unit's description on its own line above the plot: “monthly donation”; the labels carry its prefix, suffix and magnitude
a legend above the plot, below the title, centred over the plot: labels beside the bars of a cluster would each need a leader (G5.7, G5.10, D-7)
legend entries in the order of the bars in each cluster, left to right: Cash, Credit card, Cheque (G5.8, G5.14: square keys)
